verdict.why: Chat recovery now always runs, and `chatRecovery: false` silently gets the default configuration.

draft.detail: Previously compiled JavaScript that still supplies chatRecovery false receives the default recovery configuration

test.error: FAIL: agents 0.21.0 chatRecovery false resolves to enabled: false, so durable recovery is disabled

source.quote: `chatRecovery` accepts `true` or a configuration object; `false` is no longer supported. Previously compiled JavaScript that still supplies `false` safely receives the default recovery configuration.
